summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Confirmed account takeover. The account shows a classic password-spray pattern: three failed portal sign-ins followed by a successful sign-in, all from the same IP (185.213.44.9, SprayNet AS, Moscow, RU). The successful auth had mfa_prompt_count=0 and no device_id, meaning no MFA challenge was presented and no trusted device was bound. A successful authentication from a high-risk foreign spray IP after repeated failures indicates the attacker obtained valid credentials and accessed the account, so the account should be contained (session revocation, password reset, MFA re-enrollment, and mailbox audit).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
